comments.author: Yasumi
comments.body_html:
Yesterday, I spent several hours investigating why the helicopter crash does not appear on the client side. I even set up a second SPT installation on my laptop and used it as a second client. The result was that the laptop hosting the raid could see the crash site, while my main PC joining as a client could not.

I also noticed an error later on: “Undefined packet in NetDataReader”, which led me to suspect that a recent Fika update may have broken the Fika Sync addon. While recreating the server to check for mod conflicts, I discovered that after starting a headless raid, the crash site appeared correctly.

The only relevant change was adding WTT – CommonLib. After that, the error disappeared, and the HC console showed the log: “Info : WTT-ClientCommonLibFika - Registered StaticSpawnPacket handler”

My conclusion is that the Fika Sync addon likely requires WTT – CommonLib to function correctly.
